versions.changelog:
Initial release of PubMed literature search skill.

- Search biomedical literature on PubMed via NCBI E-Utilities.
- Supports keyword, Boolean, field-qualified, and PMID-based queries.
- Customizable parameters: result count, NCBI database, API key, email, and full abstracts.
- Outputs clickable PMID, title, author, source, date, and DOI.
- Includes search best practices and guidance on identifying research gaps.
- Bundles Python script (`search_pubmed.py`) using Biopython for command line use.
